text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, has anything good happened to
you
today?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
As you know, Machan dreams of
becoming the
world's favorite mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And according to the dictionary, a
mascot is a
lucky charm, someone who
brings good fortune.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So with that in mind, Trainer, has
anything good
happened to you today?
